project.name: HC-SR04 diagnostics
project.goal: Characterize registered trigger/echo behavior without overstating distance accuracy.

targets.label: HC-SR04
limitations: Geometry, alignment, and speed of sound affect the estimate.

setupChecklist: Trigger uses GPIO16 through 1 kΩ; Echo uses an 8.2 kΩ/10 kΩ divider into GPIO17; the divider output was verified below 3.3 V.

reference.description: No independent distance reference is declared.
